verdicts.reason: A keeps a sensible logo, headline, image, CTA order, but the legal line is blown up larger than the schedule. The six-session list is shrunk to unreadable size and out of date order (13 Jan first), and the 'Winter Programme' eyebrow is stranded at the very bottom. B is worse: the schedule is split into fragments (three rows above the image, single rows sandwiched around the CTA), and the headline sits below its own list items. The logo is pushed to the bottom corner, and the fine print is crammed beside it, nearly colliding with a list row, so grouping and reading order are broken.
